title: Timed-out runs lose usage already recorded in the trajectory
reasoning: A timed-out invocation raises before extracting trajectory usage. Streaming parsing supplies neither cost nor tokens, so even when the interrupted process left a valid trajectory with billable usage, that usage never reaches self.usage. Failed runs consequently underreport consumption or retain earlier values.
reproduction: Have an invocation return timed_out=true while its output directory contains a valid trajectory with nonzero accumulated usage. Catch AgentError and inspect self.usage; the trajectory totals were not applied.
recommendation: Account for available trajectory usage before raising the timeout error, while preserving the timeout failure.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included for usage accounting when an invocation terminates with a timeout.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover successful and timed-out invocations with recorded usage, asserting identical extraction of available totals and continued error propagation for timeouts.
